comment: Independent C-first dogmove.c quickmimic mounted pet branch. Source 1478-1488 dismounts a steed with DISMOUNT_POLY before appearance changes; dog_eat reaches it via m_consume_obj on a mimic corpse. Generate a tame saddled carnivorous gray dragon and scout its placement before mounting. Earlier hero-eats-mimic and leashed-dog cases have different caller/state. Own C scout places gray dragon northeast of hero, hero (52,16), dragon (53,15), and small-mimic corpse i. Dismiss inventory, use #ride northeast and answer the source force-mount question yes, then drop i on the mounted steed tile. Require actual steed eating and forced dismount before appearance change. C-only direction correction: exact expanded C glyph coordinates put the gray dragon (52,15), directly north of hero (52,16). The northeast attempt found nobody; retain it and mount north instead. Source-guided material variation: the mounted gray dragon is still carrying droppable generated inventory, so dog_invent selected that branch instead of food. A tame saddled warg is an animal carnivore with no generated tool inventory and satisfies the dog-class saddle rule; test the same mounted mimic meal with this distinct real species/state. Its actual placement must be observed if the mount direction misses.
